# balena_application_environment_variable (Data Source)

Reads the one application environment variable (the `application_environment_variable` resource of the `/v7` API) that matches every configured attribute. At least one attribute must be set, and exactly one row must match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "balena_application_environment_variable" "example" {
  id = 123456
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Optional

- `application_id` (Number) ID of the referenced `application` (API field `application`). Changing it replaces the resource. Selects the row when configured.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the application environment variable. Selects the row when configured.
- `name` (String) API field `name` (short text). Name rules from the API's /config/vars: must not match `^\d|\W`; must not be `BALENA`, `RESIN`, `USER`; must not start with `BALENA_` or `RESIN_`. Changing it replaces the resource. Selects the row when configured.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) API field `value` (text). At most 106104 characters. Selects the row when configured.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) API field `created_at` (date time).
